description: Install in User settings (~/.claude/settings.json): Claude Code ignores this variable in project and local settings. Turns on Code Mode (experimental, Claude Code 2.1.323+), where Claude writes JavaScript that makes several tool calls in one step (parallel commands, chained results, filtered output) instead of calling Bash, Read or Edit one at a time. Interactive terminal sessions only, on the native build, with Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 or Fable 5.2; the first session asks you to confirm and Ctrl+O shows the code. Sessions started in Code Mode resume only with it on. Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode
